---
title: "Test impact of omitted continuous covariate of different strengths using rms"
---

## Setup
```{r}
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(furrr)
library(glue)
library(fs)
library(here)
library(rms)
```

```{r}
source(here("functions", "jackknife_mcse.R"))
```

## Simulation function

```{r}
run_simulation_iteration <- function(iter_num, base_path, full_data, model_formula, seed = 123, sample_size = 250) {
    # This function runs one full simulation iteration.
    
    # --- 1. Setup for the current iteration ---
    set.seed(seed + iter_num)

    # allocation ratio currently hardcoded
    tx_ids <- full_data |> 
        distinct(id) |> 
        pull(id) |> sample(round(0.5* sample_size), replace = FALSE)

    soc_ids <- full_data |> 
        distinct(id) |> 
        pull(id) |> 
        setdiff(tx_ids) |> 
        sample(round(0.5* sample_size), replace = FALSE)

    data_for_model <- full_data |> 
        filter(id %in% c(tx_ids, soc_ids)) |>
        mutate(
            tx = if_else(id %in% tx_ids, "1", "0"),
            tx = factor(tx, levels = c(0, 1)))
    
    rm(full_data)
    
    # Create datadist for the current iteration's data subset
    dd <- datadist(data_for_model)
    assign('dd', dd, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    options(datadist = 'dd')

    if (nrow(data_for_model) > 0) {
        model <- tryCatch({ 
            # Using orm from the rms package with x=TRUE for robcov
            orm_fit <- orm(
                model_formula,
                data = data_for_model,
                x = TRUE, 
                y = TRUE)
            
            # Use robcov for Huber-White robust standard errors, clustering by id
            # robcov(orm_fit, cluster = data_for_model$id)
            
        }, error = function(e) {
            message(glue("ERROR in iteration {iter_num}: {e$message}"))
            
            return(NULL)
        })
        
        # --- 7. Save the results ONLY if the model ran successfully ---
        if (!is.null(model)) {
            # Extracting coefficients from summary of the robcov-adjusted object
            # Use antilog=FALSE to suppress odds ratios
            # Specify time=c(0,1) to get a 1-unit change effect for time
            summary_df <- summary(model, time = c(0, 1), tx = "0", antilog = FALSE) |> as.data.frame() |> 
                rownames_to_column("term") |>
                # Standardize column names
                rename(Estimate = Effect, `Std. Error` = `S.E.`) |>
                # Manually calculate the p-value from the Effect and S.E.
                mutate(`Pr(>|z|)` = 2 * pnorm(-abs(Estimate / `Std. Error`))) |>
                # The term for factors is just the factor name now.
                mutate(term = case_when(
                    term == "tx - 1:0" ~ "tx=1",
                    term == "yprev - 2:1" ~ "yprev=2",
                    term == "yprev - 3:1" ~ "yprev=3",
                    term == "yprev - 4:1" ~ "yprev=4",
                    TRUE ~ term
                )) |> 
                select(-c(Low, High, `Diff.`, Type))


            return(summary_df)
        }
    }
    return(NULL)
}

```

## Sim Specs

```{r}
N_SIMULATIONS <- 1000
N_CORES <- 8
future::plan(future.callr::callr, workers = N_CORES)
```

## Run Simulations
```{r}
OUTPUT_PATH <- here("9-markov-tests", "output", "rms_non_robust")
dir_create(OUTPUT_PATH) # Ensure output directory exists
DATA_PATH <- here("9-markov-tests", "data")

effect_sizes <- seq(-1.5, 1.5, by = 0.5)

# define model specs for rms::orm
# The response variable `y` needs to be suitable for orm.
# We will ensure it is ordered in the data loading step.
main_formula <- y ~ tx + time + yprev

# Loop through each effect size, load the corresponding data, and run the simulation
for (effect in effect_sizes) {
    
    effect_str <- sprintf("%.1f", effect)
    
    message(glue("\n--- Running simulation for x_effect = {effect_str} ---\n"))
    
    INPUT_FILE <- path(DATA_PATH, glue("simulation_x_effect_{effect_str}.parquet"))
    RESULTS_FILE <- path(OUTPUT_PATH, glue("results_{effect_str}.parquet"))

    df_full <- read_parquet(INPUT_FILE) |> 
        filter(time > 0) |> 
        filter(yprev != 5) |> 
        rename(
            id = patient_id,
            y = state) |> 
        mutate(
            y = factor(y, ordered = TRUE, levels = 1:5),
            yprev = factor(yprev, ordered = FALSE)
        )
    
    # --- Run Simulations in Parallel ---
    results <- furrr::future_map_dfr(
        .x = 1:N_SIMULATIONS,
        .f = ~ run_simulation_iteration(
            iter_num = .x,
            full_data = df_full,
            model_formula = main_formula,
            sample_size = 250,
            seed = 123
        ),
        .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE),
        .progress = TRUE,
        .id = "iter"
    )

    write_parquet(results, RESULTS_FILE)
}
```

## Summarise simulations results

```{r}
result_files <- fs::dir_ls(OUTPUT_PATH, glob = "*.parquet")

process_simulation_results <- function(file_path) {
    filename <- fs::path_file(file_path)
    
    # Extract the omitted covariate's effect strength from the filename
    x_effect_strength <- as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(filename, "-?\\d+\\.\\d+"))
    
    sim_data <- arrow::read_parquet(file_path) |>
        filter(term == "tx=1")
    
    # Calculate Type I error and its MCSE
    type_i_indicators <- sim_data |> pull(`Pr(>|z|)`) < 0.05
    type_i_error_rate <- mean(type_i_indicators, na.rm = TRUE)
    type_i_error_mcse <- jackknife_mcse(estimates = type_i_indicators)
    
    # Calculate Bias and its MCSE (true effect is 0)
    estimates <- sim_data |> pull(Estimate)
    bias <- mean(estimates, na.rm = TRUE)
    bias_mcse <- jackknife_mcse(estimates = estimates)

    # Return a tibble with formatted columns
    tibble::tibble(
        `X Effect Strength` = x_effect_strength,
        `Sample Size` = 250,
        `Type I Error (MCSE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", type_i_error_rate, type_i_error_mcse),
        `Bias (MCSE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", bias, bias_mcse),
        `Simulations` = nrow(sim_data)
    )
}

summary_table <- purrr::map_dfr(result_files, process_simulation_results) |>
    arrange(`X Effect Strength`)

knitr::kable(
    summary_table,
    caption = "Comparison of Type I Error and Bias for the Treatment indicator for Varying Strengths of an Omitted Covariate (rms::orm)"
)


create_bias_table <- function(file_path) {
    filename <- fs::path_file(file_path)
    
    # Extract the omitted covariate's effect strength from the filename
    x_effect_strength <- as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(filename, "-?\\d+\\.\\d+"))
    
    sim_data <- arrow::read_parquet(file_path)
    
    # Calculate Type I error and its MCSE
    
    # Calculate Bias and its MCSE (true effect is 0)
    estimates <- sim_data |> 
        pivot_wider(
            names_from = term, 
            values_from = Estimate)
        

    bias_time <- mean(estimates$time, na.rm = TRUE) - log(0.95)
    bias_yprev2 <- mean(estimates$`yprev=2`, na.rm = TRUE) - log(10)
    bias_yprev3 <- mean(estimates$`yprev=3`, na.rm = TRUE) - log(3)
    bias_yprev4 <- mean(estimates$`yprev=4`, na.rm = TRUE) - log(40)
    bias_tx <- mean(estimates$`tx=1`, na.rm = TRUE) - log(1)

    bias_time_mcse <- jackknife_mcse(estimates = na.omit(estimates$time))
    bias_yprev2_mcse <- jackknife_mcse(estimates = na.omit(estimates$`yprev=2`))
    bias_yprev3_mcse <- jackknife_mcse(estimates = na.omit(estimates$`yprev=3`))
    bias_yprev4_mcse <- jackknife_mcse(estimates = na.omit(estimates$`yprev=4`))
    bias_tx_mcse <- jackknife_mcse(estimates = na.omit(estimates$`tx=1`))

    # Return a tibble with formatted columns
    tibble::tibble(
        `X Effect Strength` = x_effect_strength,
        `Sample Size` = 250,
        `'tx' Bias (MCSE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", bias_tx, bias_tx_mcse),
        `'time' Bias (MCSE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", bias_time, bias_time_mcse),
        `'yprev=2' Bias (MCSE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", bias_yprev2, bias_yprev2_mcse),
        `'yprev=3' Bias (MCSE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", bias_yprev3, bias_yprev3_mcse),
        `'yprev=4' Bias (MCSE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", bias_yprev2, bias_yprev4_mcse),
        `Simulations` = nrow(sim_data)/5
    )
}

bias_table <- purrr::map_dfr(result_files, create_bias_table) |>
    arrange(`X Effect Strength`)

knitr::kable(
    bias_table,
    caption = "Bias of all parameters for Varying Strengths of an Omitted Covariate (rms::orm)"
)
```
